Weeknight lemon pasta

A quick dinner in 20 minutes.

Bright, creamy and ready before the water has fully cooled. This is the pasta we make when the fridge is nearly empty and everyone is hungry.

Ingredients

  • 400 g spaghetti or linguine
  • 2 lemons, zest and juice
  • 60 g butter and a splash of olive oil
  • 80 g grated parmesan, plus more to serve
  • A handful of basil, black pepper and salt

Method

  1. Cook the pasta in well-salted water until just al dente. Keep a mug of the water.
  2. Melt the butter with the oil and lemon zest over low heat.
  3. Toss the pasta with the butter, lemon juice, cheese and a little pasta water.
  4. Finish with basil and pepper, and serve straight away.
